```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(caret)
library(recipes)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(terra)
library(doParallel)

source(here::here("R/config.R"))
source(here::here("R/eval_model.R"))
```

```{r datamerge}

dataset <- open_dataset(rf_sample_data_tiles_dir, format = "parquet")
print(dataset)
print(length(dataset$files))
combined_data <- dataset |> collect()
colnames(combined_data)

```

```{r parallel}
n_cores <- 32
cat("Using", n_cores, "cores for parallel training\n")

# 创建并注册并行集群
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

# The same model formulation is in the previous chapter
pp <- recipes::recipe(vegh ~ twi + rin + dem + mat + map + srad,
                      data = combined_data
) |>
  recipes::step_center(recipes::all_numeric(), -recipes::all_outcomes()) |>
  recipes::step_scale(recipes::all_numeric(), -recipes::all_outcomes())

start_time <- Sys.time()

f_mod <- train(
  pp,
  data = combined_data |>
    drop_na(),
  method = "ranger",
  trControl = trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 3,  # 减少到3折
    savePredictions = "final",
    allowParallel = TRUE  # 开启并行计算
  ),
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    .mtry = 3,  # 固定为4（6个变量的2/3）
    .min.node.size = 5,  # 可以尝试更大的值如20
    .splitrule = "variance"
  ),
  metric = "RMSE",
  replace = FALSE,
  sample.fraction = 0.1,
  num.trees = 100, # high number ok since no hperparam tuning
  seed = 1982 # for reproducibility
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
training_time <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")
cat("Training completed in:", round(training_time, 2), "minutes\n")

print(f_mod)

# 8. 重要：关闭并行集群，释放资源
stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()  # 恢复串行模式

```

```{r print}
# 9. 可选：查看模型详细信息
print(f_mod$results)  # 查看不同参数的CV结果
sqrt(f_mod$finalModel$prediction.error)  # OOB错误率


eval_model(mod = f_mod, df_train = combined_data, df_test = NULL)

# OOB prediction error of the final model
sqrt(f_mod$finalModel$prediction.error)

# RMSE of 5-fold cross-validation
f_mod$results$RMSE

```
